text: {"lessons":["Selling part of Stock B and Stock D after large gains did not prevent my account from rising, but those gains alone are not evidence that selling was the right choice; I should base trades on my plan, not recent performance.","My account value has fluctuated while I mostly held positions, so I should accept ordinary short-term volatility without reacting impulsively to each monthly change.","When considering a trade, I should check how it affects my overall allocation and keep enough cash and diversification to manage risk, rather than focusing only on individual stocks."]}
